sentences.text: ?Court No. - 85
Case :- Criminal Misc Anticipatory Bail Application U/S 438 Cr.P.C. No. - 12274 of 2022

Applicant :- Sanjeev Gautam
Opposite Party :- State Of U.P. And 2 Others

Counsel for Applicant :- Rishabh Kesarwani,Atipriya Gautam,Devesh Mishra,Sr. Advocate
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Mrs. Jyotsna Sharma,J.
1.
Heard Sri Vijay Gautam, learned Senior Advocate assisted by Sri Devesh Mishra, learned counsel for the applicant, Sri O.P. Mishra, learned A.G.A. for the State and perused the record.

2. The instant anticipatory bail application has been filed on behalf of the applicant with a prayer to release him on bail in Case Crime No. 0626 of 2021, under Sections 420, 467, 468, 471, 120B IPC,
Police Station Etmadaula, District Agra.

3. As per allegations in the FIR, an advertisement was published in paper for auction of certain properties belonging to loan defaulters; the first informant participated in auction proceeding and was a successful bidder; a sale deed was executed by the present applicant-Sanjeev Gautam in capacity of authorized officer/Chief Manager under SARFAESI Act.

It is alleged in the FIR that after execution of the sale deed/issue of sale certificate of the auctioned property, the first informant was not given possession thereof and it came into his knowledge that the property owner Yogesh Gupta had already transferred that property in 2013 in favour of a third person.
On the basis of this, FIR under Sections 420, 467, 468, 471, 120B IPC was lodged and investigated upon.

4. It is contended on behalf of the applicant that the present applicant, who was the Branch Manager in the Bank and Shail Varshney, who was Manager at that time acted in their official capacity in a Sanjeev Gautam vs State Of U.P. And 2 Others on 20 January, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/3009665/
1 bonafide manner and a sale certificate was issued under the provisions of Security Interest (Enforcement) Rules, 2002 in favour of the highest bidder.

entities.text: Sanjeev Gautam vs State Of U.P. And 2 Others
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: It is further contended that in case, the highest bidder is unable to procure the possession of the property so auctioned, the responsibility lies with the administration to assist in smooth transfer of possession and for that purpose, the applicant informed the A.D.M.(Finance and Revenue), Agra and therefore, appropriate steps for facilitating the possession of the property in question under the provisions of SARFAESI Act and Rules made thereunder were taken.
To press the aforesaid contentions, copies of relevant papers have been filed with the instant anticipatory bail application and same are available on record.
It is stressed that the matter by no stretch of imagination is criminal in nature.
Civil proceedings are going on in connection with the handing over the possession under Section 14 of SARFAESI Act.

The applicant had no criminal intention and has had no criminal antecedents and that he acted in a good faith in a bonafide manner.
5.

The application for anticipatory bail is, though opposed by learned AGA for the State, however, it is conceded that the matter is seized under the provisions of SARFAESI Act and Rules made thereunder.

It is not rebutted that the co-accused the then Bank Manager namely Shail Varshney @
Shaily Varshney has been granted anticipatory bail by a coordinate Bench of this Court in Criminal Misc Anticipatory Bail Application U/S 438 Cr.P.C. No. 12273 of 2022 vide order dated 05.01.2023.
6.

In case of Siddharam Satlingappa Mhetre v. State of Maharashtra, (2011) 1 SCC 694, it has been held by Hon'ble Supreme Court that while deciding anticipatory bail, Court must consider nature and gravity of accusation, antecedent of accused, possibility of accused to flee from justice and that Court must evaluate entire available material against the accused carefully and that the exact role of the accused has also to be taken into consideration.

entities.text: Siddharam Satlingappa Mhetre v. State of Maharashtra, (2011) 1 SCC 694
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text:
7. I considered submissions of the learned counsel for the parties, nature of accusation, role of applicant, all attending facts and circumstances of the case in the light of all the material placed before me by the rival parties, In my view, a case for anticipatory bail is made out.
8.

sentences.text: In case of breach of any of the above conditions, the court below shall have the liberty to cancel the bail granted to the applicant.
10. It is made clear that observations made herein shall not in any way affect the learned trial Judge in forming his independent opinion at any stage of the case based on material before him.
